business_summary.text: EPACK Durable Limited is a leading living appliances original design manufacturer with a focus on room air conditioners, small domestic appliances, large domestic appliances, and components.

call_points.text: No specific FY27 revenue or margin guidance provided, but confident in surpassing industry growth of 20% for AC
Industry expects a growth of approximately 15% in Q1FY27, supported by normalized inventory levels and strong summer demand.
Price hikes of 15% to 20% have been passed on to brand customers to mitigate commodity and forex cost increases.
Total debt stands at approximately ₹700 crore, including a term loan of ₹200 crore.
Auditors highlighted a disputed trade receivable of ₹19.61 crore from Gangnam, which is currently sub-judice.
Components segment grew 102.7% YoY to ₹366.3 Cr in FY26, driven by heat exchangers, plastic moulding, copper parts, and PCBs.
Total planned strategic capex is ₹470 Cr by Q2 FY27, with ₹297.1 Cr incurred across four facilities in FY26.
Added 17 new customers in FY26, bringing the total customer base to 72.
FY27 outlook supported by improved summer conditions, normalized inventory, and operating leverage potential.

timeline.summary: Sanjay Singhania, Promoter of EPACK Durable Limited, declared no encumbrance on shares held by him and his promoter group for FY2026, filed April 2, 2026.
Delhi High Court remanded EPACK Durable's customs show cause notice to CBIC for re-adjudication with no immediate financial impact.
EPACK Durable released its Monitoring Agency Report for Q4 FY26, confirming full utilization of ₹379.44 Cr IPO net proceeds.
EPACK Durable received Entitlement Certificates under RIPS-2024 from the Government of Rajasthan for its Bhiwadi manufacturing facility.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹591.05 Cr, net profit to shareholders ₹0.02 Cr (-99.9% YoY) (includes ₹2.18 Cr from discontinued operations; continuing operations ₹2.2 Cr).
EPACK Durable released Q4FY26 investor presentation detailing RAC demand softness, ₹32.42 Cr PLI reversal, and non-AC diversification.
EPACK Durable Limited’s **Esha Gupta** uploaded the audio recording of the Q4FY26/Annual Results Conference Call on May 21, 2026, available at [epackdurable.com](https://epackdurable.com).
EPACK Durable reported Q4FY26 revenue of ₹591.05 Cr and net profit of ₹0.02 Cr, alongside a ₹32.42 Cr PLI reversal.

EPACK Durable Limited held Q1FY27 earnings call on August 12, 2026, reporting 34% YoY revenue growth to ₹886 Cr and EBITDA margin of 6.21%, with updates on diversification strategy, Hisense partnership, and margin outlook.

Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹439.33 Cr (+106.0% YoY), net loss to shareholders ₹25.07 Cr (against a loss of ₹22.25 Cr a year earlier) (includes ₹3.17 Cr from discontinued operations; continuing operations ₹21.9 Cr).
EPACK Durable Limited reported Q2 FY27 financial results for quarter ended September 30, 2026, revenue INR 4,393 Mn, EBITDA INR 71 Mn, net profit margin 1.62%.

Audio recording of the Investors’ Conference Call on the Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the Quarter and Half Year ended September 30, 2026 was uploaded on the Company’s website on October 30, 2026.
